meta.name: migrate-slack-agents
meta.description: Migrate a classic single-bot Slack install to one provisioned Slack app per existing agent group while preserving agent identities, workspaces, memory, and wiring behavior — or record the operator's choice to stay on classic, which remains supported. Use when /update-nanoclaw surfaces the Slack agents requirement, or standalone any time later.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 迁移 Slack 机器人架构为每组独立应用，保留身份与记忆
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在使用经典 Slack 机器人并需按 agent 分组独立应用
copy.tagline_en: Migrate classic Slack bots to per-agent apps, preserving identities and memory
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a classic Slack bot setup and need per-agent Slack apps

howto.what: 把经典单机器人 Slack 安装改成每个已有 agent 组一个独立的 slack-<slug> 机器人,保留各组原有身份、工作区与记忆;也可以只记录操作者选择继续用 classic。全程由操作者确认、可中断后接着跑,不会新建 agent 组,也不改 agent 工作区。
howto.when: 当 /update-nanoclaw 弹出 Slack agents 要求时,或之后任何时候单独运行 /migrate-slack-agents 时接管。

say.text: 给我看 Slack 迁移的 dry-run 清单,先别动任何东西
我不迁移,继续用经典 Slack,把这个决定记下来
say.note: 不做改动,仅确认更新要求

say.text: 对 <组名> 跑 finish,slug 用 <slug>,房间先不建
say.note: 按记录创建或复用该组的应用

howto.what_en: Turns a classic single-bot Slack install into one named slack-<slug> bot per existing agent group, preserving each agent's identity, workspace, and memory. Operator-guided and resumable; it never creates or edits agent groups.
howto.when_en: Triggers when /update-nanoclaw surfaces the Slack agents requirement, or when you run /migrate-slack-agents standalone later.

say_en.text: Show me the dry-run map of the Slack migration first
I'll stay on classic Slack — record that decision
say_en.note: No changes; just acks the update

say_en.text: Run finish for <group> with slug <slug>, no room yet
say_en.note: Creates or reuses that group's app
